## LLM016 Tool method returns a reactive type

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm016 |
| Turn it off | `LLM016: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM016` on the command line |

When the model calls a tool, the framework wants a result it can put straight back into the context. Return Mono/Flux and nobody subscribes for you: at best the model gets the object's toString, at worst serialization fails and the whole turn returns 500.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM016` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm016 -->

## What it looks like

A `@Tool` method returning `Mono` / `Flux`.

## How to fix

Return a plain value. The framework does not await reactive results, so the model receives an empty string and the call looks successful.
